user.title: Macless Haystack
user.description: Choose how the integration gets the FindMy reports.

endpoint.title: macless-haystack endpoint
endpoint.description: Set the address of the macless-haystack endpoint. Add the user name and password when the endpoint has basic authentication.

apple.title: Apple ID
apple.description: Enter your Apple ID. The integration logs in one time and keeps the session. The password is not stored.

two_factor.title: Second factor
two_factor.description: Choose how Apple sends the verification code.

accessory.title: Add accessory
accessory.description: Paste the accessory JSON. You can export the file from the Accessories page of the macless-haystack web portal.

reauth_confirm.title: Apple ID
reauth_confirm.description: The Apple ID session expired. Enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: Apple refused the login. Check the Apple ID and the password. See the log for the exact reason from Apple.
error.invalid_accessory: The accessory JSON is not valid.
error.no_2fa_methods: Apple did not offer a second factor.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.login_failed: The Apple ID login failed. Start again.
abort.reauth_successful: The Apple ID session is new.
